why_not: I do want to quit bottled water, but I've never heard of Claro and all I get is a 'supplier rating' of 150 L. I'd rather pay about the same for a Brita or LARQ bottle I already know than risk a rebadged knockoff with a filter subscription stuck to it.

I'd be tempted because I follow the creator, but I only fight bad hotel water a few times a year, and nothing here tells me what the filter actually takes out. Paying almost $68 up front, or $63 for just the bottle with shipping, is too much on faith.

I only hate the water a few times a year when I'm in a hotel, and I've got a Brita at home, so $68 up front plus a filter subscription is way too much for a problem I barely have. The cheaper route without a plan is still $63 with shipping, which is a lot on my income.

I already have a bottle that works fine, and I fill it from the gym fountain anyway. Sixty-eight bucks up front plus a subscription to keep it going is a lot for something I don't really need on $53k.

I like the idea of ditching bottled water, but $68 up front, or $63 for just the bottle once you add shipping, is a lot on my budget for something I'd carry on my commute. And it locks me into another subscription I'll probably forget about.

Buying the bottle alone comes to $63 with that $13 shipping, which is ridiculous, and the only way around it is signing up for a filter subscription I know I'll forget to cancel. A 5% creator code isn't enough for me to pay $68 today for a gym bottle.

I already have a bottle I like, and my office and home tap water are fine. The only way to get the decent bottle price is to sign up for another filter subscription, and I've been burned by those before.

I already have a LARQ that I'm happy with and it comes with me on the commute every day. I don't see what Claro does better, and I'm not paying $68 today plus a filter subscription to swap out a bottle that isn't broken.
